kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish كرپیچ (kerpiç, “unbaked brick”) comparing the raw states of bricks and this pastry, in the form كَرْبِيج (karbīj), then using كَرَابِيج (karābīj) as a plurale tantum, then back-forming كَرْبُوجَة (karbūja), كَرْبُوج (karbūj).
s: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish كرپیچ (kerpiç, “unbaked brick”)
g: A sort of hard, plum-sized cookie, normally made with semolina and nuts
